coaching: Clean comment — call type, priority, and the key facts are all present and consistent. What a comment like this has not been tested against yet is a caller who gives you the facts out of order and changes one of them halfway through. Run a difficult-caller scenario before you call this settled.
model_comments: Cold burglary at RP's residence on Halsted. Garage entered, window forced on RP's sedan; laptop and wallet taken from the back seat. Suspect(s) gone on arrival. RP has photos of the damage and wants a report for insurance.
